answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: each agent earns rewards into an orchard of locked tranches released over many epochs, like an inlet letting only mature fruit flow through. Fresh fake accounts can pulse activity early, but leaving forfeits every unreleased tranche, so short-lived sybils collect nearly nothing. Attackers must fund, age, and keep hundreds of wallets alive across the full vesting horizon, paying fees and locked capital per identity, making fake identities costlier than their rewards.
